categories.main_business_segments: SynPower Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three main business segments: AI machine vision equipment, wet process intelligent equipment, and production intelligent automation integration solutions. The company also engages in the sales and agency of various parts, consumables, and specialty materials related to these products, along with providing technical consulting services and import-export trade related to these products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced AI and deep learning algorithms for high-precision defect detection and classification in machine vision systems. It integrates optical imaging, software recognition, precision machinery, and automation technologies to develop automated inspection and measurement equipment. Additionally, it develops intelligent wet process equipment with chemical concentration monitoring and automatic replenishment, and integrates IoT and AI for smart factory solutions, including AR/VR and mixed reality for production visualization and management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: SynPower serves primarily the printed circuit board (PCB) industry, including manufacturers of HDI, flexible, rigid-flex, and IC substrates. It also targets the semiconductor industry, especially wafer front-end and back-end packaging inspection equipment. Key end markets include telecommunications, automotive electronics (such as advanced driver-assistance systems), consumer electronics, high-frequency communication boards, and AI-related semiconductor applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan, China (including Dongguan and Kunshan), Thailand, and India, with sales and service networks covering Taiwan, Greater China, Northeast Asia, and Southeast Asia. It maintains local subsidiaries and service centers in these regions to provide timely after-sales support and technical services.
categories.supply_chain_position: SynPower operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the development, manufacturing, and integration of inspection and automation equipment for PCB and semiconductor production lines. It also supplies specialty chemical materials used in PCB surface treatment processes, positioning itself as both an equipment and materials provider within the manufacturing ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on advancing AI-driven machine vision inspection, smart manufacturing integration (AVRIOT solutions), and energy-saving wet process equipment. R&D priorities include developing sub-micron resolution inspection systems, integrating multi-technology inspection methods (optical, X-ray, laser), expanding into 12-inch wafer inspection, and collaborating with partners like Keyence and industrial research institutes. It also emphasizes ESG goals by incorporating energy-saving modules and carbon reduction solutions into its product lines.
categories.revenue_model: SynPower generates revenue primarily through the sale of self-developed and agency machine vision inspection equipment, wet process intelligent equipment, and integrated automation solutions. It also earns income from specialty chemical materials sales and technical consulting services. The company’s revenue is derived from product sales, system integration projects, and after-sales technical support.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with domestic and international equipment manufacturers in the PCB and semiconductor inspection and automation sectors, including Japanese, Korean, and Chinese firms. SynPower differentiates itself through its comprehensive product portfolio combining self-developed technologies and agency products, strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and localized service network. It holds a leading position in Taiwan and China’s PCB inspection equipment market, with over 90% penetration in major PCB manufacturers for automotive, server, and mobile applications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, SynPower reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$1.59 billion, representing a 24.22% growth over the previous year, and a net profit of NT$50.48 million, up 46.36%. The company’s total assets increased by 32.77% to NT$2.85 billion, with equity growing 13.78% to NT$1.29 billion. It maintains a stable growth trajectory supported by increased orders from AI and semiconductor-related markets and ongoing capital investments in new production facilities.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: SynPower emphasizes its unique value proposition of providing comprehensive, high-precision AI machine vision inspection and smart manufacturing integration solutions tailored to customer needs. Its competitive differentiation lies in combining proprietary R&D with agency products, offering multi-technology inspection capabilities, and delivering localized, timely after-sales service. The company also integrates energy-saving and carbon reduction features into its equipment, aligning with ESG trends and helping customers improve production quality, efficiency, and sustainability.
